test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'TEACHING' is written as 'GVZXSRMT', 'TENDENCY' is written as 'GVMWVMXB'. How will 'SYMBOLIC' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/badffeea8c62d3ab0257e56c90dbbed1899ec42c5b0201f742e9170ea5e878ee.png] 

**Logic: Alphabet are arranged according to opposite letters.**

'TEACHING' is written as 'GVZXSRMT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d4a8bf52e26ff18450db49c6b11d9e245f5b339ce81395566080227c1fa1c8a.png] 

And,

'TENDENCY' is written as 'GVMWVMXB'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9149e0ee1543c89ae7cc9fb0458342f397bfd587f3c4375d2547d4404b494467.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbbef3266e752a31a1477006e9005f115f55044d82e8adce14b0371d1a4816e1.png] 

Hence, "**HBNYLORX"** is the correct answer.
